galasa.javaHome.markdownDescription:
Path to a JDK installation directory (Java **8 - 26** supported).

- The extension also tries `#java.home#`, `JAVA_HOME`, then `PATH`.
- Example: `/opt/jdk-21` or `C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21`.

galasa.cliPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the **galasactl** executable, or its containing directory.

- If empty, the extension searches `PATH`, then `~/.galasa/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `/usr/bin`, `/opt/galasa/bin` (POSIX) or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\galasactl`, `%ProgramFiles%\galasactl` (Windows).
- Install via [Galasa CLI release](https://github.com/galasa-dev/galasa/releases) or `brew install galasa-dev/tap/galasactl`.

galasa.cliTimeoutMs.markdownDescription:
Timeout (milliseconds) for non-interactive `galasactl` invocations. Set `0` to disable.

- Times out → exit code `-2` and a `Timed out after Nms` line appended to stderr.
- Increase to `300000` for slow ecosystems / long IPL-driven Z-host calls.

galasa.home.markdownDescription:
Override for **GALASA_HOME** — the directory holding `bootstrap.properties`, `overrides.properties`, `credentials.properties`, the local RAS, and named environments.

- If empty, defaults to the `GALASA_HOME` environment variable, else `~/.galasa`.
- The extension creates this directory if missing on activation.

galasa.bootstrap.markdownDescription:
Reference to the **bootstrap.properties** of your Galasa ecosystem.

- `file:///home/me/.galasa/bootstrap.properties`
- `https://galasa.example.com/api/bootstrap`

If empty, falls back to the `GALASA_BOOTSTRAP` env var, then `file://${galasa.home}/bootstrap.properties`.

galasa.requestor.markdownDescription:
Value injected as `framework.run.requestor` for every locally-launched run. Appears as the requestor in the RAS.

- Use your e-mail or RACF / AD username (e.g. `alice@example.com` or `TSOUSER@PLEX1`).
- Avoid putting secrets here — it is recorded verbatim in run history.

galasa.overrides.markdownDescription:
When `true`, contents of `${galasa.home}/overrides.properties` are merged into the per-run override file before each local debug session.

- Disable to launch with a clean override set.

galasa.maven-remote.markdownDescription:
Public Maven repository used to resolve Galasa managers and test dependencies.

- Behind a corporate firewall, set this to your Artifactory / Nexus URL (e.g. `https://artifactory.example.com/maven-public`).

galasa.maven-local.markdownDescription:
Local file-system Maven cache consulted **before** the remote repository.

- Useful for air-gapped environments. Example: `/home/me/.m2/repository`.

galasa.version.markdownDescription:
Galasa framework version to embed when building a per-run uber OBR.

- `LATEST` uses the extension's `symbolicversion`.
- Otherwise pin to e.g. `0.42.0`.

galasa.bootJarPath.markdownDescription:
**Required for local debug.** Absolute path to the Galasa boot jar containing the launcher main class.

- Example: `/opt/galasa/0.42.0/galasa-boot-0.42.0.jar`
- Download from the [Galasa releases page](https://github.com/galasa-dev/galasa/releases).

galasa.bootLauncherMainClass.markdownDescription:
**Required for local debug.** Fully-qualified main class inside the boot jar.

- Standard value: `dev.galasa.boot.Launcher`

galasa.uberObr.markdownDescription:
Optional Maven coordinate of an **uber OBR** (Galasa managers bundle) to load before the per-workspace OBR.

- Format: `mvn:group/artifact/version/obr`
- Example: `mvn:dev.galasa/dev.galasa.uber.obr/0.42.0/obr`
- Leave empty to use only the workspace-built OBR.
galasa.uberObr.patternErrorMessage: Must be empty or of the form mvn:group/artifact/version/obr

galasa.testAnnotation.markdownDescription:
Annotation that marks a Galasa test method in Java sources.

- Default `@Test` (matches Galasa's `dev.galasa.Test`).
- Change if your team uses a custom annotation alias.

galasa.testAnnotationImport.markdownDescription:
Optional fully-qualified import that must be present alongside `#galasa.testAnnotation#`.

- Example: `dev.galasa.Test`
- Leave empty to skip the import check (annotation alone suffices).

galasa.simbankJarPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the **SimBank distribution jar**. Required for `Galasa: Launch Simbank`.

- Download `galasa-simplatform-<version>.jar` from the [Galasa releases page](https://github.com/galasa-dev/galasa/releases) (look under `modules/simplatform/galasa-simplatform-<ver>/`).
- Example: `/opt/galasa/0.42.0/galasa-simplatform-0.42.0.jar`.

galasa.examplesArchivePath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to a **zip archive** containing example projects (e.g. SimBank tests).

- Download `galasa-simbank-tests-<version>.zip` from the [Galasa releases page](https://github.com/galasa-dev/galasa/releases).
- Example: `/opt/galasa/0.42.0/galasa-simbank-tests-0.42.0.zip`.

galasa.examplePackagePrefix.markdownDescription:
Java package prefix used in the bundled examples. New project names reuse this prefix when scaffolding.

- For SimBank: `dev.galasa.simbank`
- For your own examples archive: match the prefix of the example project folders inside the zip.

galasa.exampleSubdirectories.markdownDescription:
Subdirectory suffixes generated for each example project.

- For SimBank: `["manager", "tests"]` produces `<prefix>.manager` and `<prefix>.tests` projects.

galasa.examplePomPlaceholder.markdownDescription:
Token in `pom-example.xml` replaced with the user-chosen package name during scaffolding.

- Default: `%%prefix%%` (matches Galasa SimBank archives).
